help_cue_balance_miss: I cannot find that account in your portfolio.
help_cue_balance_many: You have {n} accounts in {bank}: check them in Portfolio.
help_banks_body:
Open My banks and reconnect if a warning appears.
Tap Update once.
Check the month and bank in Spending; use Import history for earlier months.
help_cash_body:
Create Cash in Portfolio if it does not exist yet.
Open Record cash expense and enter the purchase and amount.
Save with Cash selected; the ATM withdrawal is not the purchase.
help_categories_body:
Open the transaction in Spending.
Choose the correct category.
Save and review future suggestions before accepting them.
help_debts_body:
Open Plan → Debts.
Add the loan with its balance and instalment.
Link each charge only once.
help_goals_body:
Open Plan → Goals.
Create the goal and enter its target and date.
Review the monthly saving assigned to it.
help_history_body:
Open Import history.
Choose the bank and period.
Review every transaction before importing it.
help_intro: Type or dictate what you want to do. I answer in one sentence and take you there.
help_limited: You have reached the temporary request limit. The guides remain available.
help_placeholder: You can dictate it with the keyboard mic
help_question: What do you need help with?
help_receipts_body:
Open Plan → Bills.
Review what is pending and what was paid.
If an old charge is missing, use Import history and do not record it twice.

tour_1: 💰 Here's your money at a glance: how much you have in total and how the month is going.
tour_settings: 👉 On Home, swipe left-to-right to open Settings — height doesn't matter.
tour_2: 🧾 “{gastos}” is day-to-day only (groceries, bars, clothes…). Filter by month, category or bank. Bills do NOT go here.
tour_3: ➕ The + button in the centre logs an expense or income right away — no need to open a tab.

tour_6: 👤 Tap the circle up top to open your profile.
tour_pulldown: ⬇️ On Home, swipe down to open your profile (and again to close it).

h_subs: Payments that repeat monthly for the same amount (Netflix, gym…). The app detects them in your spending: check you still use them.
h_reserva: Each rule sets its amount aside when you save it and then each month when you open the app: it's deducted from your monthly budget and added to the goal you pick, so the reserved money actually feels set aside. Rules you already had keep splitting detected income, with your confirmation.
ru_interest_hint: TR pays {p}% p.a. on your cash, credited on the 1st. The app adds it automatically at each month close so the balance doesn't drift. Enter the rate TR currently gives you (shown in their app).
h_ru: Trade Republic rounds every card purchase up to the euro and invests the spare change (round-up). Saveback is a 1% reward for paying by card. This card tracks how much is moving and into which investment.
h_afford: Type a purchase you're considering (amount and day) and I'll tell you whether you can afford it without going into the red before payday.
h_recon: Compares what YOU have written down (bills, instalments) with what the bank actually charged. If something doesn't match or is missing, it flags it.
ac_share_all: Counts in full in your net worth
ac_share_title: How much of this account is yours?

ac_share_joint_hint: This looks like an account with two holders. If only half is yours, set 50 % and your net worth will count only your share.
ac_legacy_q: {bank} has {n} older movements that don't say which account they came from. Are they all from this account?
ac_legacy_sub: It applies to all {n} at once, the biggest ones included. Only your net worth and its chart change; you can undo it right here.
ac_legacy_done_yes: Older {bank} movements with no account count as this account's.
ac_legacy_done_no: Older {bank} movements with no account count as another account's.
ac_legacy_done_other: You assigned older {bank} movements with no account to another account.

ac_role_diario_d: This is the card you pay groceries and bars with.
ac_role_ambos_d: Bills and day to day come out of here.

Several card banks: set “Daily spending” or “Everything” on each. Switching roles keeps the shown balance.

bi_hint: Export your transactions from the broker app (Trade Republic: Profile → Activity/Documents → Export CSV) and upload it here, or paste the text. Everything is processed ON YOUR PHONE: the file is never uploaded anywhere.
bi_err: Couldn't read the CSV (odd format?). Paste a few lines and tell me its columns.
bi_err_pnl: That's the «Profit and Loss statement»: it only lists what you ALREADY sold, not what you hold. I need the «Account statement» (the top one under Documents). Careful: one of them is named «trading-account-statement» but is a P&L inside.
bi_err_fiat: ✓ This is your normal € account statement, and I read it fine: it's where I get what your gold and silver cost you, and I've kept it. What's missing are the OUNCES: now upload Invest → Documents → «Commodities» → «Account statement» and I'll put the two together (if you'd uploaded it before, upload it again: this time the cost will show).
bi_metal_hint: 🥇 Commodities: this statement only carries OUNCES. What you paid in € lives in your NORMAL Revolut account statement (the euro one, outside Invest): upload that too and I'll work out the up/down myself. If you'd rather, type the total cost in € below and that'll do.
bi_metal_auto: 🥇 The cost comes from your € account statement: each conversion to metal is matched with the euros you put in at that exact moment. If it doesn't square with your Revolut app, type the total cost below and yours wins.
bi_unmatched_hint: ⚠ Positions without a clear match stay on «don't touch»: pick where each one goes (or create new). Square shares and cost against your Revolut app before applying — only what you map gets touched.
bi_cash_info: ℹ Found {int} of interest and {div} of dividends in the statement. The app doesn't add them automatically: to square the cash, re-anchor the account balance.
bi_usd_hint: CSV amounts are read as €. Careful mapping to $ positions (marked).
bi_apply_hint: On apply: shares and cost are re-anchored to the statement (broker truth) and value is rescaled to the last known price. Right after, live prices refresh automatically by ticker.
ih_intro: Keeping your expenses in a spreadsheet, a Word document or a PDF? Upload it and I'll bring them in. It doesn't matter what your columns are called or what order they're in: I'll guess what each one is and you fix me if I'm wrong.
ih_steps: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Word (.docx) or a PDF with real text (not a scanned photo) all work. If yours is an old .xls or .doc, open it and «Save as» → .xlsx or .docx.
You need a column with the date, one with the description and one with the amount. The rest is optional.
You check it before saving: I show you what's coming in and what you already had.
ih_privacidad: The file is read on your phone. It is never uploaded anywhere.
ih_err_xls: That's an old Office format (.xls or .doc) and I can't read it. Open it and «Save as» → .xlsx or .docx (or download it as CSV).
ih_err_zip: That doesn't look like a valid Excel or Word file. Try opening it and saving it again as .xlsx or .docx.
ih_err_vacio: I opened the file but found no rows with data in it.
ih_err_leer: I couldn't read the file. If you can, save it as CSV and try again.
ih_err_pdf_imagen: This PDF looks like a scanned image (it has no text inside) and I can't read it. If you can, convert it to Excel, Word or CSV, or enter the data by hand.
ih_err_pdf_filas: I read text from this PDF but couldn't find rows with a recognisable date and amount. Try converting it to Excel, Word or CSV.
ih_leidas: {n} rows read. Tell me what each column is:
ih_signo_hint: If income comes with a minus sign (or as a negative) in your sheet, pick «expenses and income mixed» and I'll split them.
ih_faltan: I'm missing the date, the description or the amount: without those three I can't record anything.
ih_malas: {n} rows I couldn't read (no date or no amount) and they stay out.
ih_dup_hint: Duplicates are dropped on their own: same day, same amount and same description as something you already had. Your history is not touched.
ih_hojas_intro: That file has {n} sheets with data. Which one do you want to bring in?
ih_fin_s: {n} new expenses in your history. You can see them in Expenses, and they count towards your totals.
bi_rev_steps_btn: How to export the Revolut CSV
bi_rev_steps: «Brokerage account» → «Account statement». Do NOT take the «Profit and Loss» one: it only lists what you already sold.
Got gold or silver? Go back and repeat with «Commodities» → «Account statement». They live in a SEPARATE statement: without it your metals don't come in.

And to know how much you're making on them? A THIRD one is needed: the statement of your NORMAL Revolut account (the euro one, outside Invest). That's where the € you put into each conversion live; the Commodities one only carries ounces.
Format «Excel», from account opening to today → «Get statement».
On the phone open it with Google Sheets → «Make a copy» and download as CSV (or save/share it and upload here).
Upload them all at once below, or one at a time: I keep merging them. Processed on your phone, never uploaded.

ef_create_title: How much cash do you have?
ef_create_sub: Count the notes in your wallet. It adds to net worth and you can spend from it.
ef_cajero_bank_sub: Pick the account the cash came from.
ef_cajero_sub: From {bank} to cash. Net worth stays the same.
ef_in_sub: Tip, change returned, someone paid you… Only raises the envelope.
ef_need_bank: You need another account to say where it came from.
ef_neg_warn: The envelope goes negative ({x}). Did you forget to log an ATM withdrawal?
ob2_budget_t: How much do you want to spend per month?
ob2_budget_d: Your day-to-day budget (groceries, eating out, treats…). The app warns you before you go over.
tr_apply_hint: On apply: shares, value and cost are re-anchored to what Trade Republic says right now (live data, no need to refresh prices).
mi_expired: Your MyInvestor session expired and couldn't renew itself. Sign in again (username remembered): password and, if asked, the SMS code.
mi_hint: Log in with your MyInvestor user · the password is never stored.
mi_need_login: To connect MyInvestor, first sign in to Aely (top, «Sign in»).
mi_otp_intro: MyInvestor texted you a code. Type it here:
mi_recaptcha: 🛡 MyInvestor's anti-bot is demanding a captcha and the app can't solve it. Don't retry repeatedly (it extends the block): wait a few hours and retry from your home WiFi. It usually clears on its own.
mi_rc_key_hint: Advanced: to let the app try to solve the captcha itself, paste MyInvestor's reCAPTCHA «site key» here. How to get it: on your computer open MyInvestor's website, open dev tools (F12) → Network tab, filter «recaptcha», and copy the «render=6L…» value (starts with 6L).
mi_rc_key_saved: ✓ Site key saved · on connect, the app will try to solve the captcha itself.
mi_rc_fail_gen: 🛡 Google wouldn't issue a captcha token inside the app (MyInvestor's site key only works on their own website). The site-key shortcut can't do more: wait a few hours and retry from your home WiFi.
mi_rc_rejected: 🛡 The app generated the captcha token but MyInvestor rejected it (it checks where it was generated). Nothing more can be forced from the app: wait a few hours and retry from your home WiFi.
mi_rc_badge_note: Protected by reCAPTCHA · Google's privacy policy and terms apply.
mi_preview: {n} positions found. Choose which of your positions each maps to:
mi_err: Couldn't connect to MyInvestor. Check username/password or the code, and try again.
tr_err: Couldn't connect to Trade Republic. Check phone/PIN or the code, and try again.
tr_expired_re: Your Trade Republic session really expired. Reconnect: your phone is already filled in — just PIN and a fresh code.
lt_top: {cat} takes the biggest share, as almost always.
drag_hint: press and hold a card to move it
g_dup_sub: The bank brought it again with no name. If it's the same one you already have, the one with the real merchant stays. If they are two different charges, both count.
g_filters_hint: Pick categories and banks. Empty = show all. By default you see every bank marked as day-to-day spending.
ai_cat_none: No clear suggestion — pick by hand
ai_cat_off: Turn on “Suggest category (AI)” in Settings → Notifications
g_cycle_budget_hint: Pay starts the cycle. Later income, including Bizum payments and rent, raises money left; transfers do not.
g_cycle_filter_hint: This filter runs from the last detected payment to today; it does not change the monthly budget.
g_cycle_fallback: The budget follows the calendar month.
g_cycle_none: Log your pay as a 💰 income and put “Salary” in its description. Until it is recognized, your budget follows calendar months.
sub_tofixed_done: ✓ "{n}" added to Fixed expenses ({b}). To have it truly charged there, change the card on the subscription's site.
sub_dismissed_ok: Dismissed · won't show up here again
sub_hint: Charges to the same merchant in ≥3 months with similar amounts. Check if you still use them.
st_gview_split_d: Total spent on top; income and net balance (income − spending) below, on one line.
st_gview_net_d: The balance leads (income − spending for the period); spending and income shown small below. Green if money is left, red if you overspent.
st_budget_cycle_d: With recognized pay, Spending opens in My cycle and counts spending and income. Without pay, calendar months apply. The Android widget stays monthly.
sv_note: Plan what you set aside each month to estimate when you reach your goals. It does not move real money or create transactions.
sv_empty: No contributions yet. Tap «Edit» to add what you set aside each month.
g_refresh_expenses_hint: Fetches expenses saved in the cloud, including notifications. It does not contact your banks.
g_empty_d: Change the filter, sync or add one.
g_empty_period_d: That's normal if the month or your cycle just started — they'll show up as you sync or add one.
af_sub: Simulate a purchase and see the impact
af_enter: Type an amount to simulate the purchase.
af_tight: 🟠 You can, but it'd be very tight
af_low: Your lowest point this month would be {x} (day {d})
af_low_noday: Your lowest point this month would be {x}
af_floor_break: 🟠 You can, BUT you'd dip below your {x} floor
af_safe: 💚 Today you can spend up to {x} safely
af_fin_fixed: Your fixed costs would go from {a} to {b}/mo
af_fin_margin_tight: 🟠 Tight: the instalment eats over half your free margin ({x}/mo)
af_fin_margin_no: 🔴 It doesn't fit: your free monthly margin is {x}
af_fin_margin_none: Log your salary (Plan → Manage → income) and I'll tell you if the instalment fits each month.
af_fin_hint: Instalment estimated at 0%. If it carries interest, create the debt and set the APR in Plan → Debts.
inv_alsoinvested: Also adjust what's invested (if I bought or sold)
inv_hint_edit: Type the current value of each position (tap to select). The gain % is calculated automatically.
inv_hint_view: «USD prices» fetches quotes for tickered stocks automatically. Anything without an automatic price (funds, gold, some ETFs) is edited via «Edit manually». USD→EUR rate: {fx} · live ECB.
inv_sell_sub: Enter the percentage (30 = 30 %). Value, cost and shares are adjusted, and the proceeds are logged as sold.
inv_delete_sub: This doesn't touch your broker: it only removes it from the app.
ru_sub_simple: each purchase adds a little to your investing
ru_hint_simple: Every time you pay by card, the app rounds the purchase up to the whole euro and that difference is invested on its own. Plus, Trade Republic gives you 1% back on what you pay with its card, and that's invested too.
ru_plan_hint: {x}/mo leave your TR cash and buy {inv} (your savings plan). This keeps your TR balance right with no manual tweaks.
ru_hint: Round-up rounds each purchase up to the next € × multiplier and leaves your TR cash towards {inv} (TR invests it on the 2nd/9th/16th/23rd). Saveback is a 1% TR gives you, invested on the 2nd. The app applies it to your cash and investment when each month CLOSES. Estimate from your logged spending: your real TR balance always wins.
ru_hint_off: Turn it on if you use Round-up or Saveback in TR, so your TR cash matches reality (TR moves that spare change into investments).
ru_manual_hint: You can type the REAL amount you see in TR to correct the estimate (leave empty to auto-calculate).
pj_hint: On what's already invested ({x}). The band is ±2% on the rate. Estimate, not a guarantee.
pt_trb_hint: 💳 = card purchase (counts toward round-up). 🔄 = bizum/transfer (does NOT count). If a bizum is tagged 💳, change it in Expenses so it doesn't inflate round-up. This balance recomputes itself: base + payroll − spending − round-up. A SMALL mismatch vs TR is normal: TR credits cash interest on the 1st (set it in Investments → Round-up so the app adds it) and invests round-ups/saveback on the 2nd/9th/16th/23rd. If it bothers you, edit the balance in Accounts and it re-anchors.
db_pending_sub: drops on its own each month
db_financing_hint: Set a term in months for a financing: the payment shows up by itself in Fixed costs each month and stops when it ends. If 0%, leave the payment empty (I compute it). For interest, enter the real payment.
db_balloon_hint: Car? Down payment upfront + installments + a big FINAL PAYMENT at term end. Enter the financed amount, the final payment and the term: the installment is computed and the final payment shows as a charge in the last month.
db_hint: The balance drops on its own each month based on what you pay off. When you get the real bank balance, edit it here and it re-anchors. The payment and payoff (if different, e.g. you pay 197 € but pay off 250 €) are set in Fixed → Debt payments.
db_err_quota: ⚠ Set the payment/mo or the term in months
db_err_paid: ⚠ You've paid as many installments as the term: that debt is already settled
db_paid_hint: Already partway through? Enter how many installments you've paid and the outstanding balance is computed for you.
db_amortize_prompt: How much of “{name}” do you pay down?
db_amortize_sub: Outstanding now: {x}. Whatever you enter drops the balance and shortens the term, keeping the same payment.
db_est_zero: Estimated balance: €0. Confirm whether the bank has settled it.
db_settle_sub: Confirm the real balance. This does not create a payment or change saved transactions.
db_settled: ✓ Settled. You can archive it without losing its payments.
db_archive_hint: They remain saved so you can find linked payments.
db_delete_sub: You can only delete a debt with no linked payments.
db_delete_linked: This debt has linked payments and cannot be deleted. Keep it in the list or archive it once settled.
da_rate_hint: Give the debt its interest rate (it's in your contract or the bank's app) and I'll tell you what early repayment saves. For 0% financing, put 0.
da_amount: How much would you pay down?
da_cut: You'd drop {n} payments: done by {d} instead of {d0}.
da_nocut: That amount doesn't remove a whole payment (it trims the last one).
da_saved: ≈ {x} less interest between now and the end.
da_wait: Every month you wait, this debt costs ≈ {x} in interest: if you're going to do it, sooner is better.
da_rate0: At 0% there's no rush to pay down{p}: that money works harder in your pocket.
da_beats_cash: Paying down “earns” you a guaranteed {a}%, beating the {b}% on your cash: worth it.
da_under_cash: Heads-up: your cash earns {b}%, more than this debt's {a}%. The math favours the cash… though killing debt buys peace of mind too.
da_first: 🥇 With several debts, pay down the highest interest first: “{name}” ({p}%).
da_apply_sub: The balance drops and the term shortens with the same payment.
da_est: Estimate using the app's linear model: the exact figure depends on your bank's math.
lk_escape_sub: On this device only. You can re-enable it from your account.
au_toin: Already have an account? Sign in
au_reset_sent: 📩 If the email exists, we've sent you a link to change it.
bk_auto_hint: Daily backups are kept in the cloud for 30 days. Open and compare them without changing your portfolio.
gl_contribute_prompt: How much do you add to “{name}”?
gl_contribute_sub: It adds to what you've already saved for this goal.
gl_eta: At your pace ({x}/mo) you'll hit it in {when} 🟢
gl_eta_behind: You need {x}/mo to make it in time 🟠
gl_eta_nosaving: Start saving to see the forecast
sh_empty_d: Create a group to split trip, flat or event expenses with others.
sh_noexp: No expenses yet. Add the first one.
sh_delgroup_q: Delete this group and its expenses?
gl_empty_d: Create your first savings goal and watch it get closer each month.
rr_edit_monthly_hint: Past contributions stay unchanged. If this rule has already been applied this month, changes will apply next month.
rr_edit_income_hint: Past distributions stay unchanged. Changes will apply to the next income you distribute.
rr_err_changed: This rule changed or was deleted. Cancel and reopen it to edit the current version.
rr_delete_sub: Any remaining reservation that can be verified is released from the budget. Contributions already saved towards the goal and their history are kept; no money moves.
rr_none: You don't have any rules yet. Add one: its amount is deducted from this month's budget and added to the goal when you save it, and again each month, when you open the app.
rr_detect_sub: Received on {d}. Based on your rules, here's the split:
rr_remainder: And {x} is left for daily spending, untouched.
rr_err_amount: Enter an amount above 0, for example 1200 or 1200.50.
rr_err_pct: The percentage must be above 0 and no more than 100.
rr_err_goal: Choose a goal that is still active.
rr_st_pending: There's income from {d} waiting to be split: confirm it in the notice above.
rr_st_applied: The income from {d} has already been split. Rules you add now don't change that split: they apply to the next one detected.
rr_st_dismissed: You chose “Not now” for splitting the income from {d}. Your rules will apply to the next one detected.
rr_st_none: There's no detected income to split right now. Your rules are waiting for the next one.
rr_st_noplan: These rules have no amount to split. Check the rules and their goals.
rr_m_ok: This month: {x} deducted from the budget and added to the goal.
rr_m_base: This month: —. Without a monthly budget the percentage can't be worked out.
rr_m_meta: This month: —. The goal is no longer active.
rr_m_hint: When you save, the amount is deducted from this month's budget and added to the goal, with nothing else to confirm. It repeats each month, when you open the app.
bank_error_invalid: That permission was already used or expired · tap Reconnect again and finish only that one authorization
bank_error_busy: An authorization is already in progress · finish it before opening another
bank_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in a little while.
bank_err_eb: The bank rejected the authorization · try again
bank_err_sin_code: The bank code was missing · tap Connect again and finish only that authorization
bank_err_state: That authorization doesn't match · tap Connect again from the app
bank_err_sin_cuenta: The bank returned no account · check at the bank and reconnect
bp_tr_ob: adds your transactions (the balance still comes from the broker)
bank_syncfail: I couldn't read the bank balance now. Do not reconnect; try again later
bank_sync_sin_nube: I couldn't fetch your data from the cloud, so I didn't check the bank (to avoid repeating transactions). Try again in a moment
bank_syncsoft: {bank}: the bank didn't answer just now. No need to reconnect; try again later
bank_nolink: this account isn't linked in Enable Banking yet (restricted mode). Link it in the Enable Banking control panel and reconnect.
pv_s1: Your portfolio: accounts, investments, debts, budget and settings (on the phone and, if you sign in, in Supabase).
Expenses: amount, merchant, category and date.
Bank connections: Open Banking link status and encrypted session tokens. We never store your bank password.
MyInvestor: encrypted session tokens after connecting. The password is only used to sign in and is not stored.
Minimal telemetry (optional): version, platform and errors — no financial data.
pv_s2: Cloud data is in Supabase (EU). The app is served from GitHub Pages. Each user can only read and write their own data (Row Level Security). Your statement CSVs are processed on the phone and never uploaded.
pv_s3: Access & portability: export your data as JSON from Settings → Backup.
Erasure: Settings → Your account → Delete my account (asks for password). Removes your user and all its data.
Rectification: you can edit any data inside the app.
bp_empty: You haven't connected any bank yet.
bp_hist_pickbank: Choose which bank to query. Initially, only daily-spending banks are selected.
bp_hist_sub: Pull the last months from: {banks}. By default they go to Spending (or Income). A recurring bill is only created if you mark it, and you'll be asked to confirm.
bp_hist_none: No new transactions in that period (or they're all logged already). Remember: the bank only shows ~90 days.
bp_hist_all_logged: Accounts shared by {bank}: {accounts}. Transactions supplied: {n}, all already logged. If another account is missing, reconnect the bank and select it; if it still does not appear, the bank is not sharing it with Aely.
bp_hist_dup: already in your Plan · counted once
bp_hist_dupmaybe: you may already have it (same amount, nearby date)
bp_hist_esrecibo: this is your bill “{name}”: it will show in Spending without counting twice
bp_hist_quizarecibo: this looks like your bill “{name}”: it will show in Spending without counting twice
bp_hist_suggest_recibo: Is this a monthly bill? Mark it as Bill if you want to create the fixed charge.
bp_hist_trunc: The bank didn't return the full period you asked for (~90-day cap or truncated). Check the oldest dates.
bank_read_reconnect: {bank}: the connection needs to be completed. Open Settings → My banks to review it.
bank_read_rate: {bank}: the temporary read limit was reached. Do not reconnect; search again in about 6 hours.
bank_read_timeout: {bank}: the bank took too long to return transactions. Received and saved transactions are kept. Sync again to retry.
bank_read_balance: {bank}: some balances could not be updated. Previous balances are kept.
bank_read_partial: {bank}: the download is incomplete. Received transactions are kept, but some may be missing.
bank_read_interrupted: {bank}: the bank or connection stopped the download before it finished. Your saved transactions are still available. Sync again to retry.
bank_read_limited: {bank}: transactions from the requested period are missing because the download reached its limit. Received and saved transactions are kept. Use Import history to look for the missing ones.
bank_read_pending: {bank}: older transactions still need to be downloaded. Sync again to continue; what you already have stays saved.
bank_read_empty: {bank}: the bank returned 0 transactions for that period.
bank_read_retry: Transactions could not be retrieved. Check your connection and search again.
bank_gap_cap: {bank}: more than 90 days without syncing. The bank connection only provides the last 90 days; anything older is not available this way.
bp_hist_sign: On {banks} almost everything arrives as income: check the sign before importing.
bp_hist_confirm_fijos_sub: They will be deducted every month, including past months. If you only want this charge once, leave it as Spending.
bp_hist_no_ack: The cloud did not confirm any transaction: the batch was not saved. Try again when online.
bp_hist_skip_dup: {n} were already there and were left untouched
bp_hist_offline: Offline: only on this phone (they may clash when you sync)
bp_hist_undo_sub: Removes that batch’s transactions. Ones you already had stay put.
bp_hist_undo_empty: There’s no recent import to undo.
bp_hist_undo_local_only: Removed on the phone. No confirmed cloud ids: nothing was deleted there.
bp_hist_undo_cloud_fail: Removed on this phone, but the cloud did not confirm the deletion. If they come back, undo again while online.
bp_hist_nofilter: No transactions match this filter. Try removing one.
exp_pull_invalid: The download could not be completed. Saved transactions are kept; please try again.
bp_pick_sub: You'll only see the accounts you authorize.
bp_need_login: Sign in to connect your bank
bp_noacct_help: You authorised the bank but no account came through. In restricted mode, Enable Banking only returns accounts you've registered in its control panel. Open the Enable Banking panel, link (whitelist) this account and tap «Try again».
bp_removed: {bank} removed · you can reconnect it whenever you want
bp_removed_acc: {bank} removed · its account leaves Wallet. All its transactions stay in Expenses
bp_rm_sub: Its transactions are NOT deleted: they stay in your history no matter what. All you choose is whether they keep counting towards this month's spending.
bp_rm_keep_sub: Only the connection is cut. Your figures stay exactly as they are.
bp_rm_sub_diario: This is your everyday bank, so its purchases always count: removing the bank cannot change that. Its transactions are NOT deleted.
bp_rm_keep_diario_sub: The connection is cut and nothing else. If you want them to stop counting, first change which account is your everyday one, in Net worth.
bp_rm_stop_sub: Its purchases leave this month's spending. Careful: past months change too, because the figure is always recalculated.
bp_which: Which brokers do you use? Tap to add or remove — you'll only see the ones you pick.
bp_apk_hint: If Trade Republic keeps logging you out: install the new APK (native fix). MyInvestor captcha is their anti-bot — wait and retry.
rec_title: Do your bills match the bank?
rec_mismatch_l: {name} — you have {modeled} written down, the bank charged {bank}
rec_new_t: 🆕 Bank charges you haven't written down
rec_shared_t: ℹ You only pay your share (you get the rest back)
rec_hint: Compares what you have written down with what the bank charged. A new charge can be “Confirm and log”-ged into your bills without typing it: it doesn't touch your balance or Spending.
pf_hint: This data stays on your phone (and Aely cloud if signed in). It is not shared with banks.
iv_no_put: Tell me what you put in and I'll show you how much they gained.
iv_refresh_fail_sub: Your latest data is still here ({time}). You can try again.
iv_missing_cost: What you put into one or more positions is missing, so the gain is not calculated yet.
iv_empty_sub: Add a broker or position to start following them here.
iv_fx_note: Amounts are calculated in euros. Dollar→euro rate: {fx}.
st_widget_bank_hint: Choose which bank's balance and spending limit to show. Accounts at the same bank are added together. This does not change which expenses count towards your budget.
g_note_unconfirmed: Note not confirmed in the cloud. Kept on this device.
g_edit_unconfirmed: Could not save the change. Please try again.
g_rename_pending: Name awaiting confirmation. Kept on this device and retried when the connection returns.
g_rename_paused: The name could not be confirmed. It is still saved on this device. Tap Retry when you want to send it again.
bk_preview_hint: Read only. Compare this backup with your current portfolio. Opening or closing it does not replace data or send it to the cloud.
bk_counts: Transactions: {copy} in the backup · {current} in the portfolio
bk_sums: Sum of stored amounts: {copy} in the backup · {current} in the portfolio
bk_sums_hint: Record check without currency conversion: this is not your balance or available spending. Equal sums do not mean equal transactions.
bk_identity_hint: Only rows with the same unique identifier are compared. Older or ambiguous records are shown separately; similarity does not prove they are the same payment.
bk_recovery_limit: This view does not apply a restore. Recovering data in a shared portfolio requires reviewing decisions and changes made after the backup.
bk_invalid_root: the content is not a valid object
bk_invalid_arrays: data lists are missing or malformed
bk_invalid_deleted: the list of deletions is malformed
bk_invalid_json: some data is not compatible with a backup
g_auto_separated: The two transactions have been separated
g_auto_edit_separated: Change saved. The notification and bank entry have been separated
plan_edit_invalid: Check the amounts and day. Use positive numbers, with a comma or dot for decimals.
db_err_term_quota: The term and payment do not match the remaining balance. Check the term or payment.
db_extend_unknown: A term cannot be calculated with this APR without knowing how much principal each payment repays. Check the term with your bank.
db_err_quota_range: With {n} payments left, the payment must be between {min} and {max}.
db_err_quota_min: With {n} payment left, the payment must be at least {min}.
db_edit_quota_zero: There is still a balance left: the payment cannot be 0.
db_finished_edit_hint: Completed debt: only non-financial details can be changed.
plan_edit_changed: This item changed or was deleted. Close and reopen the editor to see the current version.
db_term_hint: Total term, including payments already made. Leave blank if unknown.
db_edit_projection_changed: The projection has changed. Review the details and save again to confirm it.
db_rate_edit_hint: Blank = unknown interest. 0 = no interest. Saved when you tap Save changes.
gl_delete_sub: The goal will disappear from the list. Rules and past contributions are kept.
